### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-email`, `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks`, `@objectstack/service-settings`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx`  _(via SysWebhook (symbol, a top-level const object), sys_webhook (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via sys_webhook (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`  _(via settingsCommon (symbol, a field of const object en; a field of const object esES; a field of const object jaJP; a field of const object zhCN))_
- `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`  _(via sys_webhook (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`  _(via settingsCommon (symbol, a field of const object en; a field of const object esES; a field of const object jaJP; a field of const object zhCN))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via sys_webhook (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via sys_webhook (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`  _(via sys_webhook (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **15** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `63a954befe9850fcb3469561346c190edb84d999` — the merge of head `47f77a523f5a54b5588dad9babd86395bc704660` into base `847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 63a954befe9850fcb3469561346c190edb84d999 && git checkout 63a954befe9850fcb3469561346c190edb84d999
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14 47f77a523f5a54b5588dad9babd86395bc704660 && git checkout -B drift-repro 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14 && git merge --no-ff 47f77a523f5a54b5588dad9babd86395bc704660

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：设置页（认证、功能开关、邮件）的帮助改为业务用语，环境变量名等技术细节移出句子；继承值徽标改「组织」；Webhooks 副标题与测试邮件结果文案改写；公司「国家」和本地化「默认国家」改为显示国名、存储代码的选择器。四个语言包同步。
- 为什么改：Setup → Settings 的说明像代码注释，国家要手打两位代码、打错没有提示（#27853、#27867）。
- 风险与回滚：`Clause-②: no`；国家仍按 `iso_3166_alpha2` 值域校验，接受的值不变；其余是文字。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`company.manifest.ts`（国家选项由共享的 249 个代码生成）、`auth.manifest.ts`、`settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts src/manifests/country-picker.pin.test.ts` 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无（非受管；不需契约复审；席位按本任落地授权落地）。

席位意见：ACCEPT。

## 席位核对

Head-sha: `47f77a523f5a54b5588dad9babd86395bc704660`

- **Shape:** help strings in the auth / feature-flags / mail manifests and their four packs carry no env var, enum key, object API name or code call in the sentence; `sourceLabels.tenant` reads the organisation layer; the Webhooks subtitle and the Send-test-email result messages are reworded; Company `country` and Localization `default_country` become selects over the shared ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes with display names, keeping `valueDomain: iso_3166_alpha2`, so the accepted set is unchanged. 20 files, +479 / −81. `check-governed-merges --pr 28063`: NOT governed.
- **Premise measured:** on `main` the help strings quoted env vars and enum keys, and Company Country was a two-letter free-text box; #27867's premise was partly off (Company has no Locale or Timezone; Localization's `locale` is already a picker and `timezone` the deliberate #5712 combobox), corrected in the PR body. Package suites service-settings 1053, plugin-webhooks 258, plugin-email 749, typecheck ×3 green; two ablations red as expected; `dispatch-gates` 62 derived, 61 exit 0, 1 measured by CI (os-dev report 6521433006).
- **Gate check-runs on the head:** 48 runs, 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure/pending; `mergeable_state` clean. The head is `b7cfa217` plus a merge of `main`, re-run after the claim records were repaired for `check:closing-target-claim`.
- **Contract review:** not owed (`check-owed-reviews` lists nothing for this PR).
- **Accepted deviations:** the surface took `plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts` (message strings) and `localization.manifest.ts` (`default_country`) by claim amendment before the edit.
- **Out of scope, filed:** #28068 (console shows a stored country code, not its name, in the box), #28069 (AI & Embedder / Knowledge help, the rest of #27521 row 2).
- **Landing:** under the maintainer's landing grant for this seat term (seat 4 thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z): `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay.
